name: Moxie Docs
tagline: Connect a GitHub repo and Moxie writes the documentation, flags drift when code changes, and serves your conventions to AI agents over MCP
description: Connect a GitHub repo and Moxie writes the documentation, flags drift when code changes, and serves your conventions to AI agents over MCP. What you get: - Living documentation. Generated from source, searchable alongside your existing Markdown, rewritten when the code moves. - Drift detection. Each merge is compared against the docs it affects. No more guides describing code that shipped differently six months ago. - MCP context for AI agents. Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex pull your convention
